newsitem.title: SPAIN: Nissan to invest 100 bln ptas in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to invest 100 bln ptas in Spain.

text.p: Japanese carmaker Nissan Motor Co Ltd's Spanish unit Nissan Motor Espana said in a statement on Wednesday that it would invest 100 billion pesetas ($690 million) in Spain in the next five years.
"This affirms the decisive role of Nissan's Spanish operations in the context of the brand's global strategy at a European and world level," Nissan said.
Nissan said from 1998 it would produce a new range of Nissan trucks and the new Trade van in the Avila factory of Nissan Vehiculos Industriales SA.
From 2000 it will produce, in stages, an all-terrain vehicle and two van types at its Barcelona Zona Franca Nissan Motor Iberica SA plant.

"Nissan is showing its will to strengthen its operations in Spain as a centre of research and development and specialised production of vans, all-terrain, commercial and industrial vehicles," the statement said.
